svg.desc: Comprehensive wireframe board for all 21 Admissions CRM screens. Staff admin screens (Dashboard, Constituents, Duplicates, Inquiries, Applications List, Application Review, Communications, Campaigns, Events, Leads, Reports, Audit, Settings, RAG Assistant) and Applicant Portal screens (Landing, Application Form, Status, Events, Public Inquiry).
svg.text: Admissions CRM v1 — Complete Wireframe Board
21 screens covering all PRD workflows. Angular admin design language: sidebar + breadcrumb + Material forms + statistic cards + hover tables.
